name: MetricParser

test_list.description: Reject NaN, infinity, multiple values, invalid UTF-8 and over-limit output.
Accept a single exact named result amid logs; duplicate or malformed result lines fail closed.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Actual successful fixed-harness output, bounded to at most 64 KiB.

output_description: A unique finite metric; runner exit status must be verified separately.
